metadata.scenario: A customer calls to dispute a charge on their recent invoice, stating that they were overcharged for a service. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Patricia Wilson. I'm calling about a charge on my recent invoice. Hello, Patricia. I’m sorry to hear that. Could you please provide me with more details about the charge? Yes, I was billed for post-surgery care, but I believe I was overcharged for the service. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account and the details of that invoice. Thank you. It was for my mother’s care after her hip replacement, scheduled for next week. Got it. Please hold on for a moment while I review the invoice. Alright, I see the charge here. The invoice reflects our rate for post-surgery recovery care, which is between $85 and $110 per session. Yes, but I was charged $125, which seems higher than what I was quoted. I apologize for any confusion, Patricia. Let me check if there was an error in the billing. It appears there may have been an additional service added that wasn’t discussed. I’m sorry for any oversight on our part. That makes sense, but I’d like to dispute this charge. Absolutely, I can help you with that. I’ll need to document your dispute and investigate further. How long will that take? Typically, it can take up to 3-5 business days for a billing dispute to be fully reviewed. Okay, I just want to ensure it’s resolved before my mother’s care begins. I understand. Would you like me to follow up with you once the investigation is complete? Yes, that would be great. Can you also confirm the correct charges for her post-surgery care? Of course! The rates for post-surgery recovery care are $85 to $110. Would you like to schedule the sessions now? Yes, let’s schedule those. I want to ensure we have everything in place. Perfect! I’ll assist you with that after we resolve the billing dispute. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Patricia. I’ll make sure to follow up with you shortly about the dispute. Sounds good. Thank you! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day!
